desc:
🌿 Double jump quickly to fly! Welcome to Isle of Dragons, a peaceful sanctuary of wonder, roleplay, and flight!!! 🐉

💫 Soar through enchanting landscapes, explore ancient secrets, roleplay and hangout with friends, and watch your creature grow through the ages! 🌟

Please note: The game is currently in a Pre-Alpha stage. Bugs and limited features are expected as we continue to build the world - thank you for your patience and feedback!

✨ [ Key Features ]
🕊️ Enjoy relaxing exploration with friends, old and new
🐣 Play as a dragon and grow through unique life stages
🌍 Discover a vast world full of secrets and places to visit
🧙‍♀️ Roleplay and forge new stories and journeys with friends

Tags: Isle of Dragons, Dragon, Dragons, Creature, RP, Roleplay, Exploration, Fantasy, Adventure, Open World, Growing, Hatchling, Birds
